title: MultiVoice Assist Overview
question: What is MultiVoice Assist?
content: MultiVoice Assist is a lightweight, offline-capable multilingual voice assistant built using Flutter. It provides local RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) search, Speech-to-Text, device Text-to-Speech, and SQLite chat history without requiring commercial AI API keys.

title: Key Features
question: What features does MultiVoice Assist have?
content: Key features include: 1. Offline Local RAG search 2. Speech-to-Text input 3. Device Text-to-Speech audio output 4. SQLite chat history storage with search 5. Multilingual language auto-detection (English, Tamil, Hindi, Malayalam, Telugu, Kannada, Arabic) 6. User authentication and profile management with image cropping 7. RAG Debug demonstration screen.

title: Key Features Tamil
question: MultiVoice Assist-ன் சிறப்பம்சங்கள் யாவை?
content: முக்கிய அம்சங்கள்: 1. ஆஃப்லைன் உள்ளூர் RAG தேடல் 2. குரல் மூலம் உரை உள்ளீடு (Speech-to-Text) 3. சாதன உரை-பேச்சு ஒலி வெளியீடு (Device TTS) 4. SQLite மூலம் அரட்டை வரலாறு சேமிப்பு 5. தமிழ், ஆங்கிலம், ஹிந்தி உள்ளிட்ட பன்மொழி ஆதரவு 6. பயனர் சுயவிவர மேலாண்மை.

title: Speech Recognition Feature
question: How does speech recognition work?
content: Speech recognition uses the flutter `speech_to_text` package to access your device's native microphone. You tap or press and hold the microphone icon to convert spoken audio into text in real-time.

title: Text to Speech Feature
question: How does text to speech work?
content: Text-to-Speech uses the device's native TTS engine via `flutter_tts`. Clicking the speaker icon reads the AI answer aloud using the appropriate locale voice (en-US, ta-IN, hi-IN, ml-IN, te-IN, kn-IN, ar-SA) completely offline.

title: Supported Languages
question: Which languages are supported?
content: MultiVoice Assist supports 7 major languages: English (en), Tamil (ta), Hindi (hi), Malayalam (ml), Telugu (te), Kannada (kn), and Arabic (ar).

title: Local RAG Architecture
question: How does local RAG work in MultiVoice Assist?
content: Local RAG operates in 5 steps: 1. Detect language from user input via Unicode analysis. 2. Tokenize and normalize user query. 3. Perform TF-IDF & keyword matching on local JSON knowledge base. 4. Rank and extract top relevant context chunks above the minimum relevance threshold (0.18). 5. Generate a grounded response from retrieved context.

title: Offline Functionality
question: Does MultiVoice Assist work offline?
content: Yes! MultiVoice Assist works 100% offline without internet connection or API keys. The knowledge base is stored locally on the device, speech recognition uses native device APIs, and text-to-speech uses on-device TTS synthesizers.

title: Offline Functionality Tamil
question: MultiVoice Assist இணையம் இல்லாமல் வேலை செய்யுமா?
content: ஆம்! MultiVoice Assist 100% இணையம் இல்லாமல் ஆஃப்லைனில் வேலை செய்யும். இதற்கு API சாவிகள் (API keys) எதுவும் தேவையில்லை.

title: SQLite Database & History
question: How is chat history stored?
content: Chat history is saved locally in an SQLite database file (`chat_history.db`) using the `sqflite` package. Users can view, search, delete individual chats, or clear all history.

title: Authentication & Security
question: How does user authentication work?
content: Authentication operates locally using `SharedPreferences`. User login credentials (email and password) are validated on-device. Default demo credentials are admin@gmail.com / admin123.

title: User Profile Management
question: How to edit user profile?
content: Users can edit their name and email in Profile Screen, select a custom avatar picture from device gallery using `image_picker`, crop it into a circle using `image_cropper`, and save it locally.

title: RAG Debug Mode
question: What is RAG Debug mode?
content: RAG Debug screen is a demonstration feature designed for evaluation and faculty presentation. It displays the raw query, detected language code, top 3 retrieved knowledge entries with exact relevance score percentages, and final constructed answer.

title: API Key Requirements
question: Is any commercial API key required?
content: No commercial API key (OpenAI, Groq, Gemini, or HuggingFace) is required. MultiVoice Assist is completely self-contained and free from paid cloud services.

question: இதற்கு ஏதேனும் API சாவி தேவையா?
content: இல்லை, இதற்கு எந்தவொரு வர்த்தக API சாவியும் தேவையில்லை. பயன்பாடு முற்றிலும் இலவசமானது மற்றும் ஆஃப்லைனில் இயங்கக்கூடியது.

title: Unknown Questions Handling
question: What happens if a question is not in the dataset?
content: If the user asks a question whose relevance score is below the threshold (0.18), the assistant will strictly refuse to hallucinate and return: 'I couldn't find this information in my knowledge base.'

title: Flutter Technology Stack
question: What technology stack is used in MultiVoice Assist?
content: MultiVoice Assist is built using Flutter & Dart. Key packages include: provider (state management), sqflite (database), speech_to_text (voice input), flutter_tts (voice output), image_picker & image_cropper (profile image handling), and shared_preferences (local key-value storage).

title: Voice Chat Screen
question: How to use Voice Chat mode?
content: Navigate to Voice Chat screen from the app menu. Press and hold the big circular microphone button while speaking, then release to automatically send your speech to the Local RAG engine.

title: Language Auto Detection
question: How does automatic language detection work?
content: Language detection analyzes the Unicode character ranges of user text. For instance, characters in range \u0B80-\u0BFF are identified as Tamil (ta), \u0900-\u097F as Hindi (hi), and \u0600-\u06FF as Arabic (ar).

title: Searching History
question: How to search past chat history?
content: Open the History Screen and type in the search bar. The list filters past questions and answers matching your query instantly in real time.

title: Deleting History
question: How to delete chat history?
content: In History Screen, tap the red trash bin icon next to any message to delete that single chat, or tap the top trash icon to clear all saved conversations from SQLite.

title: Performance and Resource Usage
question: Is MultiVoice Assist lightweight?
content: Yes! Unlike heavy LLMs that consume gigabytes of RAM and heavy CPU/GPU resources, MultiVoice Assist uses in-memory JSON indexing and TF-IDF scoring, requiring less than 50MB RAM and negligible CPU usage.

title: Dark Theme UI
question: Does MultiVoice Assist have a dark theme?
content: Yes, MultiVoice Assist features a modern, clean dark theme with indigo, violet, and dark slate blue palette designed for comfortable low-light usage.
